title: Orsen and the Spire
author: Ada Marchetti
blurb: Jude Halloran, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
